o1: Enables GTPase activator activity. Predicted to enable Rho GTPase activator activity. Involved in mitotic cleavage furrow ingression; mitotic spindle midzone assembly; polar body extrusion after meiotic divisions; cytokinesis; and the establishment or maintenance of cell polarity. Located in mitotic spindle midzone and plasma membrane. Is part of centralspindlin complex. Is expressed in germ cell; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital dyserythropoietic anemia. Orthologous to human RACGAP1 (Rac GTPase activating protein 1).
